entities.summary: Edward Gibbon's six-volume History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire (1776-1789), covering 1,500 years from Trajan to the fall of Constantinople (1453). Gibbon's work established the modern historical method of critical source analysis and remains the most influential work of historiography in the English language.
